rules.name: The Unforgiven
rules.description:
• A Dark Angels army may not include an Allied detachment. In addition, during deployment randomly select 1 enemy unit in your opponent’s army with the Character special rule. If that model is slain in the Combat Phase by wound inflicted by a Dark Angels unit, the Dark Angels player gains D3 Victory points. If the chosen unit is slain by any other means or is not slain during the battle, the Dark Angels player loses D3 Victory Points.
• Dark Angels Space Marine Captains may not purchase the Chapter Master Upgrade.

rules.name: Intractable
rules.description:
Dark Angels units gain the following:
• Dark Angels Infantry, Vehicles & Walker units always count as controlling an Objective regardless of how many enemy models are contesting it.
• Dark Angels Veteran units gain the Deathwing special rule (see rules Appendix).
• Dark Angels Bike, Jetbike, Aircraft, Cavalry gain the Ravenwing special rule (see rules appendix).

sharedRules.name: Ravenwing
sharedRules.description: A unit with this special gains the Skilled Riders & Crusader special rules. A unit with this special rule can only be joined by units with the Inner Circle or Ravenwing special rules.

sharedRules.name: Inner Circle
sharedRules.description: A unit with this special can only be joined by other units with the Inner Circle special rule. A unit with this special rule has the Hatred (Chaos) special rule.

sharedRules.name: Deathwing
sharedRules.description: A unit with this special rule gains the Stubborn special rule. In addition, the unit gains the Parry special rule on all Melee weapons it is equipped with. A unit with this special rule can only be joined by units with the Inner Circle or Deathwing special rules.

rules.name: Interrogator Chaplain
rules.description:
A model with this upgrade gains the Priest (1), Stubborn, Fear (1), Inner Circle and Zealot Special rules. In addition, the Chaplain exchanges their Close Combat Weapon for a Power Maul. If a model with this upgrade inflicted the wounds responsible for removing from play a unit designated under the Unforgiven special rule (see Dark Angels Core traits), you can re-roll the D3 to determine the number of victory points obtained.
• The Interrogator Chaplain may become Priest (2) for 10pts.
o The Interrogator Chaplain may:
▪ exchange their Power Armour, Bolt Pistol, Frag Grenades, Krak Grenades and Boltgun for Indomitus Terminator Armour and Storm Bolter for 10pts.
▪ Take a Bike for 10pts.

rules.name: Watcher in the Dark
rules.description: A model equipped with a Watch in the Dark, may once per game, ignore a single Psychic Power or Psychic Weapon attack that targets the equipped unit. Watcher in the Darks are normally represented by Tokens which may be removed to track its use. Watchers in the Dark Tokens do not count for models slain or combat resolution.

rules.name: Raven Knight Bike
rules.description: A model equipped with this wargear becomes the Bike type, gaining all of the benefits of being Bike Type. The unit also gains +1 to its Toughness (T) characteristic and is equipped with a Linked Plasma Gun.

rules.name: Brilliant Strategist
rules.description:
A model with this warlord trait and his attached unit may select to gain the benefit of one of the following special rules at the start of each Battle Round:
• Sprint (1)
• Preferred Enemy (Infantry).
• Tank Hunter.
• Siege Attacker.

rules.name: Calabanite Knight
rules.description: A model with this Warlord trait and any attached unit gains the Monster Hunter special rule. While the Warlord is engaged in Combat with an enemy unit which contains a unit with the Character special rule, the first wound inflicted by this Warlord is treated as having the Precision Hits special rule.

rules.name: Fury of the Lion
rules.description: Once per game at the start of the Charge Phase, you may declare that this unit will use the Fury of the Lion. All Dark Angels units in your army may re-roll charge rolls until the end of the phase if they can draw visibility to the warlord with this trait.

rules.name: The Shroud of Heroes
rules.description: A model equipped with this Relic gains +1 to their Invulnerable Saves (to a max of 3+). If the unit does not have an Invulnerable save, they gain a 5+ Invulnerable save.

rules.name: The Eye Unseen
rules.description: A model equipped with this Relic and any attached unit gains the Fear (1) and Preferred Enemy special rule.

rules.name: Ravenwing Talon Master
rules.description: The Captain becomes the Jetbike type (gaining all relevant benefits) and may not purchase Jump Packs, Terminator Armor or a Bike. The Captain gains the Inner Circle and Ravenwing special rule. The Captain gains +1 to their Toughness (T) and Wounds (W) characteristic. The Captain also gains 1 Linked Heavy Bolter and 1 Linked Assault Cannon.

rules.name: Deathwing Strike Master
rules.description:
The Captain gains the Battle-Hardened, Inner Circle and Deathwing special rules. In addition, the Captain exchanges their Chainsword, Bolt Pistol, Frag Grenades, Krak Grenades and Power Armour for a Calabanite Blade, Indomitus Terminator Armour and Storm Bolter.
• The Strike Master may exchange their Calabanite Blade for one of the following:
o Mace of Absolution for 10pts.
o Terranic Greatsword for 15pts.
o Relic Blade for 15pts.
o Thunder Hammer for 15pts.

rules.name: Seed of Fear
rules.description: When this power is cast, the Psyker gains the Fear (3) special rule until the start of your next Shooting Phase.

rules.name: Righteous Repugnance
rules.description: When this power is cast, the Psyker and any attached unit gain the Rage special rule until the start of your next Shooting Phase.

rules.name: Mind Wipe
rules.description: When this power is cast, target 1 enemy unit within 12” of the Psyker. The target enemy unit is treated as having a Leadership (LD) characteristic of 2 until the start of your next Shooting Phase.

rules.name: Trephination
rules.description: When this power is cast, target 1 enemy model within 24” of the Psyker. The target model must take a Leadership test. On a Pass, they take 1 automatic wound with no saves allowed. If they fail, they take D3+1 Wounds with no saves allowed.
